text.this_page_isn_t: This page isn't set up yet
text.this_page_uses_cloudflare: This page uses Cloudflare Turnstile (a bot check), which is switched on but has no keys. The server's administrator needs to do one of the following, then restart the application:

text.generated_at_the_moment: Generated at the moment of viewing from currently recorded ledger activity. Only item types with recorded usable, outdated, trashed, or diverted quantity are listed; the full catalog is larger.

text.no_mailing_labels_nobody: No mailing labels: nobody selected has a complete address.

text.anything_you_need_that: Anything you need that isn't listed above:
text.no_items_are_currently: No items are currently available to request.
text.this_list_reflects_items: This list reflects items with stock on hand at the time this form was generated and may change before your order is processed. Quantities are not guaranteed until confirmed.
text.write_the_quantity_needed: Write the quantity needed next to each item below, then return this form (email, fax, or in person) to be entered as your order. Items listed here have stock currently available. If you need something not listed, use the "Other Needs" section at the bottom.

text.includes_every_order_in: Includes every order in New Order, Ready to Fill, Filling, or Filled status — anything not yet Shipped.

text.nothing_to_pick_on: Nothing to pick on this order.

text.this_is_a_live: This is a live operational snapshot generated at the moment of viewing, not an official or final report. Figures reflect activity currently recorded in the system and may be revised as data entry catches up with physical operations.

text.no_trainee_has_completed: No trainee has completed all six stations in this range yet.

text.each_number_is_how: Each number is how many actions the trainee recorded at that station.
text.no_trainee_activity_in: No trainee activity in this range.

text.already_sorted_not_on: Already sorted, not on a pallet yet — the first team builds a pallet from these and puts it on a table spot.
text.contents_slips_cut_apart: Contents slips — cut apart, one with each spot and load
text.in_round_2_each: In Round 2 each team delivers the load it shipped to its own driver at Station 5.
text.nothing_each_team_delivers: Nothing — each team delivers the load it shipped
text.nothing_the_teams_sort: Nothing — the teams sort what they received
text.orders_waiting_to_be: Orders waiting to be picked (Ready to Fill)
text.put_out_boxes_of: Put out boxes of your own goods to receive; the receiving team matches each delivery to one of these phoned-in offers.
text.sorted_goods_on_the: Sorted goods on the sorting area table

text.scan_with_your_phone: Scan with your phone camera — it takes less than a minute.

text.when_the_trainer_calls: when the trainer calls time: go to the next station on the list below (Station 6 goes back to Station 1).
